> This is a public issue. Do not paste API keys, private samples, personal data, confidential prompts, customer names, or other restricted information. Describe the system at a high level first; a private transfer method can be agreed separately if the request is in scope.

## System and use case

What does the system score or evaluate, and what decision does the score support?

## Main concern

Which failure matters most: superficial gaming, missed content degradation, paraphrase instability, model-version regression, or something else?

## Available access

Can the system be accessed through an API, run locally, or evaluated from score files supplied by you?

## Expected scope and timing

Approximately how many representative baseline samples are available, and when is the result needed?

## Data restrictions

State only the category of restrictions here. Do not attach the restricted data itself.

- [ ] No private or restricted data is included in this issue.
- [ ] I understand that technical screening is not legal, regulatory, or psychometric certification.
